title: A witness names the rare cab
hook: Two stated cases: explore the cab prevalence before the witness report.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the cab prevalence before the witness report affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Posterior, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the cab prevalence before the witness report in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
